summary: MANAGE_ORGANIZATION_AUTH exists in both the platform gateway and controller in 2.6; the controller value is imported on upgrade, so keep both the same. Also: 2.5 and 2.6 still expose per-service APIs for compatibility, but that access will be removed, so move integrations to gateway endpoints.
questions: Do I need to set MANAGE_ORGANIZATION_AUTH in both controller and gateway?
Will the direct controller API be removed?
Should integrations use the platform gateway API?
